title: Ships loiter near subsea cables amid Iran's warnings to Trump
summary: Iran threatened to attack subsea cables if US escalates military strikes again.
llm_summary: Ships have been spotted lingering near undersea communication cables in the Gulf, a move that follows Iran’s warning that it could target those cables if the United States steps up its military strikes. The presence of the vessels raises concerns about potential sabotage of the critical infrastructure that carries global internet and phone traffic. Experts say any disruption could have widespread effects on data flow and connectivity across the region and beyond.
